name: routines

settings.name: minutes
settings.description: The most minutes one run takes, 1 to 240

settings.name: calls
settings.description: The most tool calls one run makes, 1 to 1000

settings.name: everyMinutes

settings.name: routines
settings.description: The most routines a bot can have, 1 to 100

settings.name: atOnce
settings.description: The most runs going at one time, 1 to 10

settings.name: failures
settings.description: Failures in a row before a routine pauses, 1 to 100

settings.name: keepRuns
settings.description: How many of a routine's runs to keep, 1 to 200
